name: Kreyu Conquerer [Racial]
body:
Why did the kreyu win all those wars? Big, pointy teeth.

Prerequisite(s): Kreyu, fangs of legacy, BAB +7

Benefit(s): Increase the threat range of your bite attack by 1. This can be multiplied by Improved Critical or the keen enhancement.

A Land Out of Time 2013, Little Red Goblin Games LLC, Authors: Caleb Aylsworth, Scott Gladstein, Dayton Johnson, Caleb Aylsworth, Jeremiah Zerby
